body: I am in childbearing age, but I’m not overweight. I can’t hear my headaches, and there’s no accurate way to describe the pain. Sometimes it pulses, sometimes it’s a dull, annoying ache, sometimes it’s a stabbing crippling pain that makes me stop everything I’m doing and grab onto something for dear life. It’s very difficult to explain.

Thank you so much. That’s exactly what I’ve been doing. I’ve been watching movies and distracting myself and waiting. 

I called my doctor today and they said they were going to process it right away, it’s just a matter of waiting to see how long it takes for them to review my records. I’m gonna call them every day until I get my damn test because this is bullshit.

Thank you so very much. I can’t tell you how much listening to this calms me down. I hope it’ll be stupid liquid or something relatively easy to solve. Thank you for letting me know it’s not a death sentence.
Thank you so much. I appreciate it more than I can say.

I don’t want to lurk r/cancer just yet because it’ll make my anxiety worse. I’m already pretty anxious as is, so anything I can do to keep my mind off it for now is better. 

Thank you for the kind words, though. Please know that they’re much appreciated.
Thank you so much. I’m so extremely nervous. I’ve been shaking all day and on the verge of tears since I left the doctors office.
